title: Fix flipping of gate direction in transpiler for CZ gate
notes: CZ direction handling attempted an unsupported flip and raised instead of successfully transpiling.

title: Use float-epsilon calculation in Sabre best scores
notes: Floating-point tie instability changed the Sabre best-swap set and broke seeded RNG-compatible routing on large circuits.

title: Fix random seed initialization between runs in SabreSwap
notes: No-seed SabreSwap runs could reuse the same RNG seed; this affects stochastic repeatability, not correctness of any one output.

title: Enable simplifying 1q runs and 2q blocks in transpile() without target
notes: Without a target/basis, simplifiable 1q runs and 2q blocks were left unnecessarily long.

title: Fix add_calibration bug
notes: Parameterized gate calibrations could not be converted into the DAG, causing transpile to fail.

title: Make BarrierBeforeFinalMeasurements deterministic
notes: Unordered-set iteration made later stochastic passes produce different results for the same fixed random seed.

title: Fix handling of BackendV1 simulators in PassManagerConfig.from_backend
notes: BackendV1 simulators with optional fields set to None caused errors while building pass-manager configuration.

title: Fix explicitly calibrated gates in GateDirection
notes: An explicitly calibrated gate could trigger a transpilation traceback in GateDirection.

title: Fix basis_gates and coupling_map backend override in transpile()
notes: BackendV2 target precedence ignored basis/coupling overrides and could end in an unroll TranspilerError.

title: Fix UnrollCustomDefinitions handling of empty definitions
notes: UnrollCustomDefinitions silently discarded the global phase of an empty custom-gate definition.

title: Fix CheckMap with control-flow builder nested conditionals
notes: CheckMap could raise a spurious DAGCircuitError on valid nested control-flow conditions.

title: Fix UnassignedDurationError of update_from_instruction_schedule_map
notes: Parameterized schedule durations caused update_from_instruction_schedule_map to raise UnassignedDurationError.

title: limiting matrix-based commutativity check
notes: The matrix commutativity path could allocate enormous matrices and fail with an ArrayMemoryError.

title: Removed 2pi wrapping for global phase parameter
notes: Parameterized global phase made dynamical-decoupling processing fail; exception precedence applies even though phase is the trigger.

title: Track Sabre decay heuristic on physical qubits
notes: Sabre's decay penalty tracked virtual rather than physical qubits, so its output-depth routing heuristic was evaluated incorrectly.

title: Use only discrete-basis translations in GateDirection
notes: GateDirection could choose non-discrete translations that led to unsupported-basis TranspilerError failures.

title: Allow dynamical decoupling pass to work on circuits with pulse gates
notes: Dynamical decoupling errored when a pulse-calibrated gate was present in the circuit.

title: Fix input normalisation of transpile(initial_layout=...)
notes: Valid range-like initial_layout input was not normalized and raised a TranspilerError.

title: Ensure TemplateOptimization returns native-symbolic objects
notes: TemplateOptimization returned ParameterExpression internals backed by the wrong symbolic object type while the circuit itself was returned.

title: Don't substitute ideal gates in target with Optimize1qGatesDecomposition
notes: Optimize1qGatesDecomposition unnecessarily resynthesized ideal target gates, adding avoidable translated gates.

title: Raise error eagerly on bad unitary synthesis method
notes: An invalid unitary-synthesis method is a rejected configuration; the fix only makes that error occur eagerly.

title: Fixed bug in OptimizeSwapBeforeMeasure
notes: OptimizeSwapBeforeMeasure could change the possible measured outcomes of the compiled circuit.

title: Fix SetLayout to error with invalid int list input
notes: Invalid integer-list layouts created an invalid Layout and later produced a transpiler error.

title: Fix PropertySet re-use in BasePassManager.run
notes: A stale PropertySet could be reused across runs; the documented trigger raises TranspilerError, so crash precedence applies.

title: Fix transpilation of control flow to no hardware
notes: Backendless dynamic-circuit transpilation incorrectly rejected valid control flow with a TranspilerError.

title: Remove old graph structure during EquivalenceLibrary.set_entry
notes: EquivalenceLibrary.set_entry replaced entries but left stale graph edges, so the translator used old equivalence rules while preserving unitary equivalence.

title: Fix custom constraints in transpile with BackendV2
notes: With BackendV2, custom dt/timing constraints were ignored, corrupting scheduled-duration properties while circuit operations remained correct.

title: Fix unnecessary serialisation of PassManager in serial contexts
notes: PassManager was unnecessarily serialized with dill in serial contexts, adding time/memory cost without changing the emitted circuit.

title: Make dense layout algorithm deterministic when run in parallel
notes: DenseLayout tie-breaking depended on parallel completion order, so identical inputs could choose different layouts.

title: Don't run ElidePermutation if routing is disabled
notes: ElidePermutation removed routing SWAPs even with routing disabled, turning an already mapped circuit into a worse/unmapped layout.

title: Keep identical summands when running FindCommutingPauliEvolutions.
notes: Repeated identical Pauli summands lost coefficients, changing the implemented Pauli-evolution unitary.

title: Fix OptimizeCliffordT producing non-unitarily-equivalent output when basis excludes sx/sxdg
notes: OptimizeCliffordT could emit a circuit explicitly not unitary-equivalent to its input when sx/sxdg were excluded.

title: Fix sx resynthesis of negative angles in CommutativeCancellation
notes: Negative-angle sx resynthesis in CommutativeCancellation could produce a non-equivalent circuit.

title: Use target error rates when selecting Euler basis in Optimize1qGatesDecomposition
notes: The optimizer ignored target error rates when choosing tied Euler bases, allowing a semantically correct but higher-error decomposition.

title: Fix commuting2q block parameter preservation
notes: Commuting2qBlock dropped its parameter list even for parametric gates; the documented defect is parameter metadata loss.

title: Consistent identity removal for ConsolidateBlocks
notes: ConsolidateBlocks failed to remove some identity-equivalent sequences; the fix removes them while preserving the needed global phase.
